claim: Attention GEMVs cannot be cheaply compressed below uniform-Q4 at Q4-equivalent output quality. Existing Gravity expert families (HGRAVB01 / HGRAVR02 / HGRAVS01) do not transfer. The only cheap Q4-quality action on the 86-88% mass is: (1) on mixed-1p5, drop attention+lm_head from Q8 to Q4 (they were over-protected); (2) lm_head Q3 is cosine-legal but top-1-risky and needs a generate test. Q3 on the attention mass fails the 0.99 bar, especially out_proj.

quality_bound.primary: mean row output cosine >= 0.990 vs BF16 W on real captured X (Qwen3.8 Q4 vs bf16 min cosine is 0.98948)
quality_bound.not_used: expert organ bar 0.8604 — attention is HIGH sensitivity
quality_bound.lm_head_extra: top-1 agreement vs BF16 logits on the same X. Cosine 0.99 is NOT sufficient for token identity.
quality_bound.q80_L47_k_and_o_q4_sits_at_0p9888_to_0p9: treated as Q4-incumbent, not a reason to spend Q5

activation_honesty.q80: source-bf16-capture-n192-scale64, 25258 tokens, post-attention RMSNorm (router-input). Same width, wrong residual point for in-proj. out_proj X is real-derived v*silu(z) / GQA-repeat(v)*sigmoid(gate).
activation_honesty.qwen38: activation-capture-v1, 256 tokens, CAPTURED_REAL_BF16_POST_NORM_HIDDEN width 5120. Schema name says post_swiglu but stored width is hidden, not 17408.
activation_honesty.why_this_is_not_the_known_invalid_class: every prior sub-bit negative was Gaussian-proxy. These X are real BF16-source hiddens from the same models.

HGRAVU01_uniform_group.why: geometry-agnostic; already ships on attention at Q4 (Q4 vehicle) and Q8 (mixed-1p5)
HGRAVU01_uniform_group.quality: Q4 clears 0.99 on the attention mass. Q3 typically 0.96-0.98 and fails out_proj / late k.

HGRAVB01_binary.why: encoder takes a plain matrix, but the gate_proj sign-scale recipe exploits SwiGLU sign structure that attention does not have
HGRAVB01_binary.reconstruction: algorithmically cheap; no attention kernel (expert-gate only)
HGRAVB01_binary.quality: max cosine seen 0.946 (qwen38 L63 v). Typical 0.75-0.88. FAILS 0.99 everywhere.

HGRAVR02_binary_residual.why: 2% rice residual was fit for up_proj, not Q/K/V/O or DeltaNet
HGRAVR02_binary_residual.reconstruction: EXPENSIVE_SCATTER — a LOSS even if quality passed (mixed 5.9x slower per byte)
HGRAVR02_binary_residual.quality: max cosine 0.958 (q80 L3 q). Typical 0.82-0.91. FAILS 0.99 everywhere.

HGRAVS01_act_weighted_svd.why: r160 / post-SwiGLU / in-dim 512 is a down_proj recipe. Attention in-dim is 2048 or 5120 and is not low-rank under the same fit.
HGRAVS01_act_weighted_svd.reconstruction: CONDITIONAL_TWOSTAGE — cheap iff fused y=L@(R@x). Existing kernel is expert down [2048,512] r160 ONLY. Materialize-W is a LOSS.
HGRAVS01_act_weighted_svd.quality: 0 clears of 0.99 at ranks whose BPW beats Q4. Typical 0.83-0.89 at r=512. Attention is not a low-rank organ.

HGRAVH01_hadamard.reconstruction: MEDIUM_INREGISTER_TRANSFORM (extra Walsh-Hadamard ALU, no shipping attention kernel)
HGRAVH01_hadamard.quality: q4 ~matches uniform Q4 at 4.125 vs 4.250 BPW. 2.9% save, not the mass.

expert_mlp_bundle_gate_binary_up_residua.say_so: Do not apply the routed gate/up/down recipe to attention. Measured: all three families miss 0.99 by a wide margin on every attention GEMV sampled.

reconstruction_cost_classes.measured_warning: Q80 mixed 1.4444 BPW is 5.9x slower per byte than Q4 (2.57 vs 15.2 GB/s); token 1171 ms vs 225 ms. Halving bytes with an expensive reconstruct is a net LOSS.

conservative_proposed.why: Q3 fails 0.99 on qkvz (0.981-0.984) and out_proj (0.959-0.961). Late GQA k/o Q4 already sits at 0.9888-0.9896.

q80_mixed_1p5_vehicle.today: attention+lm_head+router+shared are HGRAVU01 q8 (sensitive 3% untouched), 8.25 BPW
q80_mixed_1p5_vehicle.action: Drop attention + lm_head from Q8 to Q4. Same kernel family. Q4 vehicle already generates. This probe's Q4 cosines are 0.992-0.997 on the attention mass.
q80_mixed_1p5_vehicle.reconstruction: CHEAP_INREGISTER (this is a bit-width drop inside the existing uniform kernel, not a new reconstruct)
q80_mixed_1p5_vehicle.note: This is the largest cheap byte win this lane found. It is a policy correction on mixed-1p5, not a new codec.

if_q3_all_attention_rejected.why: out_proj Q3 cosine 0.953 (L0, kurtosis 149) / 0.968 (L32). in_proj Q3 0.975-0.980. Not a Q4-quality pack.

per_tensor_table_notes: bytes_today are Q4-vehicle group-64 body bytes (4.25 BPW exact). proposed is the conservative cheap pack (stay Q4 on attention; lm_head listed as Q4 with Q3 as a candidate).
